title: The cedar mill, ii
logline: Wednesday. The mill gate, chained. Chloe climbs it in the coat. Wood passes the dog over. The strip draws the gate from the inside.

panels.composition: The mill's gate: chain-link, chained, a sign, blackberry over everything, the stack behind. CHLOE already climbing. WOOD with the dog under his arm.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a chained chain-link gate overgrown with blackberry in front of a shuttered mill with a tall smokestack, a woman in a camel coat climbing it and a thin man holding a small dog

panels.composition: The coat snagging on the top. A thread. Chloe not stopping.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a camel coat snagging a thread on the top of a chain-link gate as the wearer keeps climbing

panels.composition: Wood passing the dog over the gate to her. Her arms out. The dog between them, above the chain.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man lifting a small dog over a chain-link gate to a woman on the other side reaching up for it, no words

panels.composition: From inside the mill yard: the gate, Wood dropping down, Chloe with the dog, the yard beyond them enormous and empty, the stack.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, seen from inside a vast empty mill yard, a man dropping down from a chain-link gate and a woman in a camel coat holding a small dog, a tall smokestack above, no words

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The gate from the inside. The coat snags.
